label: MikroTik wAP ac LTE6 kit
description: Outdoor AP with an embedded LTE6 modem: 2x gigabit, dual-band 802.11ac (300 + 867 Mbit/s), 802.3af PoE in.
notes: Vendor figures from the MikroTik product page specification table: 2x 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports, PoE in 802.3af, wireless 2.4 GHz max data rate 300 Mbit/s and 5 GHz max 867 Mbit/s. The embedded modem is an LTE Cat 6, modelled at the conservative 50 Mbit/s uplink class the catalogue uses for Cat 6 rather than a peak marketing figure.
